mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_reports (account_id, road_address, detail_address, deposit, favorite, favorited_at, risk_level) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{roadAddress}, #{detailAddress}, #{deposit}, false, NULL, #{result})
INSERT INTO report_check_results (analysis_report_id, check_type, risk_level) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{checkType}, #{riskLevel})
INSERT INTO report_fraud_types (analysis_report_id, fraud_type, risk_level) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{fraudType}, #{riskLevel})
INSERT INTO report_fraud_detail_results (report_fraud_type_id, detail_type, risk_level) VALUES (#{fraudTypeId}, #{detailType}, #{riskLevel})
mapper.select: SELECT analysis_report_id AS analysisReportId, road_address AS roadAddress, detail_address AS detailAddress, risk_level AS result, favorite, favorited_at AS favoritedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM analysis_reports WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY favorite DESC, favorited_at DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_reports WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
